correctness.rationale: Classify all nonempty contiguous factors of 0^a1^b0^c1^d by run count: one-run complementary pairs contribute 2Σ_{k≤m}z^k, two-run pairs are indexed by the union Q of rectangles [1,p]×[1,q] and [1,q]×[1,r], and three-run pairs exist iff b=c, contributing 2Σ_{i≤p,j≤r}z^{b+i+j}. Four-run factors cannot have complements, as opposite orientation absent. At z=1, inclusion-exclusion gives C=2(m+pq+qr-h+1_{b=c}pr). For b=c=t, exact reduction C/2=max(t,min(a,d))+t(min(a,t)+min(d,t)) implies upper t(n-2t+1) with equality a,d≤t. Concave quadratic optimizes at t=ceil(n/4), and b≠c case proves C≤n²/4, strictly below target n≥6. n=4,5 direct cases. Independent brute force checked 1296 compositions up to individual run length 6 and all maxima/equality n=4..40. Infinite proof is symbolic run classification and inequalities, not extrapolation.
residual_risks: Four nonempty linear alternating runs, distinct factor strings counted twice per complemented pair.
No claim about five+ runs, circular factors, positional occurrences or all-length distribution across compositions.
